title: Semistyle ANIMA | Impasto semi-realism [LORA/Anima]
description:
Semistyle (Anima) — a semi-realistic thick-paint style LoRA for the Anima base model.

Heavy painterly rendering with oil-glossy skin, dense lace and fabric detail, and dark studio-lit backgrounds. Faces stay clean anime; body materials lean realistic and glossy. Works on both LoRA-friendly checkpoints of the Anima family.

TRIGGER

semistyle (weak-trigger — the style activates even without it, but using it keeps results consistent)

RECOMMENDED SETTINGS

- Anima Turbo: 10 steps, CFG 1.0, euler / normal

- Anima Base: 30 steps, CFG 4.5, er_sde

- LoRA weight: 0.7 - 1.0 (tested stable up to 1.2)

- Resolution: 832x1216 native; 1344x2016 is the clean direct-output ceiling on 6GB VRAM. Higher resolutions break into noise — upscale afterwards instead (2x AnimeSharp gives good results).

WHAT IT DOES WELL

- Oil-painted skin sheen and rim light, wet-look fabric

- Dense black lace, floral lace overlay, bodystocking / corset renderin
